appearances.title: OpenResearch for science agent swarms
appearances.summary: alphaXiv pointed researchers to OpenResearch, a repo for running swarms of agents on science work, after an MIT ScienceClaw hackathon. Teams used it to check biological claims against literature and data, replay 62,380 recorded model calls to choose cheaper agent setups, and have separate agents review paper and simulation results.

appearances.title: alphaXiv releases a 4B decision model and OpenResearch trainer
appearances.summary: alphaXiv trained OR-decision-4B on more than 117k decision examples. It matches Jev on held-out tasks including hate-speech severity, emotion, and intent, and fails on sarcasm. Weights and the OpenResearch training code are public.

appearances.title: alphaXiv autoarxiv: swap the URL to have an agent reproduce a paper
appearances.summary: Changing arxiv to autoarxiv in a paper URL makes alphaXiv's OpenResearch set up a project and environment on your chosen compute and run a minimal reproduction, tracking logs, runs and artifacts in a local loop.
